ramon-allones-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Founded in 1837, Ramón Allones is among the oldest Habanos brands still made, and the first to pack its cigars in boxes dressed with printed labels and its emblem. Wrapper, binder and filler all come from the Vuelta Abajo. Full in strength and intense, with the Gigantes and Specially Selected as its best-known sizes, it is rich in coffee, cocoa and nuts.

thirds.notes: Dark, slightly bitter coffee and chocolate, with earth, spice and a creaminess that softens the opening.
Almond and grilled nuts come forward with coffee and chocolate, earth and a touch of leather.
Sweet nuts, hazelnut and chocolate over coffee, as the smoke rises to medium-full.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Ramón Allones Specially Selected review
Kohnhed – Ramón Allones Specially Selected (2010) review
Cigar Inspector – Ramón Allones Superiores review

ramon-allones-cuba--edicion-limitada.description: Ramón Allones entered the Ediciones Limitadas in 2011 with the Allones Extra, a 44 x 143 mm size that had left the regular range in the late 1970s, dressed in a historic band. The Club Allones, 47 x 135 mm in a box of 10, followed in 2015 and the Allones No. 2 in 2019, each rolled from leaf aged at least two years under a darker wrapper.

sources.title: Habanos – Ediciones Limitadas 2015: Ramón Allones Club Allones

ramon-allones-cuba--edicion-regional.description: Ramón Allones is also used for Ediciones Regionales, made for a single market from the brand's usual blend in sizes it does not normally carry, in numbered boxes with a silver and burgundy seal. The Gran Robusto for the Benelux, 155 x 50 mm, came out in 2007 and 2008; it begins light with hay and caramel and builds to leather and dark chocolate.

thirds.notes: Hay and grass give way to darkening caramel, with pepper, a salty edge and a first hint of walnut on a light body.
Nutty notes deepen with leather and wood, backed by fruity and floral touches as the body edges up.
A slight bitterness returns, softened by leather and a subtle dark-chocolate and caramel sweetness, now medium in body.

sources.title: Cigar Inspector – Ramón Allones Gran Robusto (Benelux Regional Edition) review
